en-US.longDescription: Guitar Pro is a sheet music/tablature editor for 4- to 8-string instruments: - guitar, bass, banjo, ukulele, etc. This is an ergonomic, comprehensive tool for beginning to advanced musicians who wish to make progress, compose, or simply play along on their guitar.
en-US.name: Guitar Pro 6
